San Francisco · On-site five days a week · Full-time · Engineering

$215,000 – $245,000 annual base salary plus equity


ABOUT INTERFACE.AI

interface.ai builds AI agents for the banks and credit unions that serve everyday Americans. Our products help members get support and complete banking tasks, while giving frontline teams better tools to serve them. Banks and credit unions across the US use interface.ai. Our mission is to make intelligent, personalized financial services accessible to everyone.


THE ROLE

As our Applied AI Engineer for Business Automation, you'll build the AI systems that run our own company. Your customers are our teams: recruiting, sales, customer success, finance, and operations. You'll find where work gets stuck, turn recurring processes into reliable automated workflows, and make sure people actually use them.

You'll own our internal automation platform: the integrations, agents, and tools that take work from request to finished outcome. Recruiting is the first priority. You'll build the systems that source, screen, and coordinate candidates. You'll work directly with CEO Srinivas Njay and with the teams who use what you build.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Workflow automation, end to end. Map how work gets done, then automate intake, context gathering, execution, approvals, and follow-through, including the exceptions and the hand-offs to people.

 - Recruiting automation. Build and run the tools that source, score, and move candidates through our hiring process alongside our recruiting team.

 - The automation platform. Build shared integrations, knowledge access, and agent orchestration that every team can reuse.

 - Production quality. Own architecture, prompts, evaluations, access controls, monitoring, and recovery, so the systems are trustworthy.

 - Adoption and results. Pilot with teams, train people, and track hours saved, cycle time, quality, and cost to decide what to build next.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You've automated real business workflows end to end across APIs and SaaS tools, and people relied on them. You can show the results.

 - You have strong applied LLM engineering skills, including tool use, retrieval, prompt design, and evaluations, and good judgment about when not to use an LLM.

 - You write production TypeScript or Python and can build the integrations, services, and interfaces people need.

 - You've integrated systems such as an ATS, CRM, Slack, finance, or HR tools.

 - You learn unfamiliar domains quickly and work easily with non-technical teams.

 - You've shipped things on your own, from early discovery to sustained use. Your track record matters more than your years.

 - You use frontier AI tools daily and can show how they changed your own productivity.

Experience building recruiting or ATS automation, or working as an early engineer at a startup, is a plus.


BENEFITS

Company-paid employee medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), paid parental leave, discretionary PTO, commuter and wellness benefits, office meals, and access to advanced AI tools.

interface.ai is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace.
